name: Federal Freight Company (FGK)
verdict: The Federal Freight Company (AO FGK) is owned by OAO RZD (Russian Railways), which is wholly owned by the Russian Federation; RZD considered selling a 49% stake in FGK in 2026 (Kommersant, Jan 2026: to be discussed at RZD's board in Q2 2026).
note: Partner of FC Lokomotiv; the ФГК logo sits on the shorts of the 2026-27 home kit (club partners page and the club's own 16 Sep 2026 match photos). Propose severe: owned by state-owned RZD; the Russian Federation has been at war with Ukraine since February 2022.
